questions.question: A person increases his speed by 40%. By doing so, he reaches his office 9 minutes before the usual time. How much time (in minutes) does he take usually to go to his office?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A person increases his speed by 40%

Time = 9 min

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

A person increases his speed by 40%

⇒ 140x/100x

⇒ 7x/5x

The ratio of the speed of man = 5x : 7x

The ratio of time of man = 7x : 5x [speed is inversely proportional to time]

Now,

The difference between the time of man = (7x – 5x) = 2x

According to the question

He reaches his office 9 minutes before the usual time

⇒ 2x = 9

⇒ x = 9/2

Time taken by him to reach office = 7x = (7 × 9/2)

⇒ 63/2

⇒ 311over2

**∴ The required time is 311over2**

questions.question: Eight years ago, the ratio of the ages of A and B was 4 : 5 and the ratio of their ages, 12 years hence, will be 13 : 15. The present age (in years) of B is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Eight years ago, the ratio of the ages of A and B = 4 : 5

The ratio of their ages, 12 years hence = 13 : 15

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Eight years ago, the ages of A and B be 4x and 5x 

The present age of A and B be (4x + 8) and (5x + 8)

Now,

The ages of A and B, 12 years hence = (4x + 8 + 12) and (5x + 8 + 12)

⇒ 4x + 20 and 5x + 20

Now,

⇒ (4x + 20)/(5x + 20) = 13/15

⇒ (60x + 300) = (65x + 260)

⇒ (65x – 60x) = (300 – 260)

⇒ 5x = 40

⇒ x = 8

Now,

The present age of B = (5x + 8) = (5 × 8 + 8)

⇒ (40 + 8) years

⇒ 48 years

**∴ The present age of B is 48 years**

questions.question: What is the ratio of the mean proportional between 24.2 and 7.2, and the third proportional of 2.8 and 4.2?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mean proportional = √(24.2 × 7.2) = √(174.24) = 13.2

Third proportional = 4.2² ÷ 2.8 = 17.64 ÷ 2.8 = 6.3

Required Ratio = 13.2 : 6.3 = 132 : 63 = 44 : 21

**∴ The correct answer is 44 : 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers for finding the mean proportional = 24.2 and 7.2

Numbers for finding the third proportional = 2.8 and 4.2

**Formula Used:**

Mean proportional between a and b = √(a × b)

Third proportional c of a and b ⇒ c = b² ÷ a

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2803454e50d003177cf97d6cf249788dc03e29f564d8d73077a2c7e57893d31.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Mean proportional = √(24.2 × 7.2)

⇒ Mean proportional = √(242/10 × 72/10)

⇒ Mean proportional = √(17424 / 100) = 132 / 10 = 13.2

⇒ Third proportional = (4.2 × 4.2) ÷ 2.8

⇒ Third proportional = 17.64 ÷ 2.8 = 6.3

⇒ Required Ratio = Mean proportional : Third proportional

⇒ Required Ratio = 13.2 : 6.3

⇒ Multiply by 10 to remove decimals = 132 : 63

⇒ Divide both terms by 3 = 44 : 21

**∴ The correct answer is 44 : 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

If three numbers a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a : b = b : c), then b is called the mean proportional between a and c. It is calculated using the formula: b = √(a × c).

Third Proportional

In a continued proportion of three numbers (a : b = b : c), the third term c is called the third proportional. It is calculated using the formula: c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

If four numbers a, b, c, and d are in strict proportion (a : b = c : d), then d is called the fourth proportional. It is calculated using the formula: d = (b × c) ÷ a.

questions.question: A shopkeeper bought 500 notebooks. He sold 300 of them for the price he paid for all 500 notebooks. He sold 140 notebooks at 20% higher rate than at which he sold 300 notebooks and the remaining at the cost price. What is the profit percentage in the whole transaction?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A shopkeeper bought 500 notebooks.

He sold 300 of them for the price he paid for all 500 notebooks. 

He sold 140 notebooks at 20% higher rate than at which he sold 300 notebooks

**Formula used:**

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the CP of 500 notebooks = Rs. 1500

CP of 1 notebook = (1500/500) = Rs. 3

He sold 300 of them for the price he paid for all 500 notebooks. 

i.e. price of a notebook = (1500/300) = Rs. 5

He sold 140 notebooks at 20% higher rate than at which he sold 300 notebooks

⇒ Rs. (140 × 5 × 120/100)

⇒ Rs. 840

Now,

The remaining notebook = [500 – (300 + 140)] = 60

He sold the remaining notebook at a cost price of a notebook = Rs. (60 × 3)

⇒ Rs. 180

Total Profit = Rs. (840 + 180) = Rs. 1020

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100

⇒ (1020/1500 × 100)

⇒ 68%

**∴ The required profit percentage is 68%**

questions.question: Let x be the greatest number by which when 448, 678 and 908 are divided, the remainder in each case is 11. When 147 is divided by x, the remainder is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The given number = 448, 678 and 908

**Concept used:**

**HCF - **The highest number among all the common factors of the given numbers

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Subtract the remainder in the given number

⇒ (448 – 11) = 437

⇒ (678 – 11) = 667

⇒ (908 – 11) = 897

Now,

The HCF of 437, 667 and 897 

⇒ 437 = 19 × 23

⇒ 667 = 29 × 23

⇒ 897 = 39 × 23

So, The HCF is 23

⇒ x = 23

Now,

When 147 is divided by x

⇒ 147/23

The remainder = 9

**∴ The required remainder is 9**

**9, 8, 7, 5, 11, 10, 13, 16, 15, 23, 19, 7, 9, 11**
questions.solution:
**Given:**

9, 8, 7, 5, 11, 10, 13, 16, 15, 23, 19, 7, 9, 11

**Formula used:**

Range = The difference between the largest number and smallest number

If n is even,

Median = [(n/2)th term + ((n/2) + 1)th term]/2

**Calculation:**

Range = The difference between the largest number and smallest number

⇒ Range = (23 – 5) = 18

Now,

Arrange the following number in ascending order

⇒ 5, 7, 7, 8, 9, 9, 10, 11, 11, 13, 15, 16, 19, 23

Total number = 14

Then, n = even

Median = [(n/2)th term + ((n/2) + 1)th term]/2

⇒ [(14/2)th term + (14/2 + 1)th term]/2

⇒ (7th term + 8th term)/2

⇒ (10 + 11)/2

⇒ 21/2

⇒ 10.5

Now,

The mean of the range and median = (18 + 10.5)/2

⇒ (28.5/2)

⇒ 14.25

questions.question: The area of a triangular field whose sides are 96 m, 110 m and 146 m is equal to the area of a rectangular park whose sides are in the ratio 10 ∶ 11. The length of the longer side of the park is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sides of the triangle = 96m, 110m and 146m = The area of a rectangular park whose sides are in the ratio 10 ∶ 11

**Formula used:**

Area of the triangle = √s(s – a)(s – b)(s – c)

Where, s = (a + b + c)/2

Area of the rectangle = length × breadth

**Calculation:**

According to the question

s = (a + b + c)/2

⇒ s = (96 + 110 + 146)/2

⇒ s = 352/2

⇒ s = 176

Now,

Area of the triangle = √s(s – a)(s – b)(s – c)

⇒ √176(176 – 96)(176 – 110)(176 – 146)

⇒ √176(80 × 66 × 30)

⇒ √(11 × 16 × 5 × 16 × 11 × 6 × 6 × 5)

⇒ (11 × 16 × 5 × 6)

⇒ 5280 m²

Area of the park = length × breadth

⇒ 5280 = (10x × 11x)

⇒ 5280 = 110x²

⇒ x² = 5280/110

⇒ x² = 48

⇒ x = 4√3 m

Now,

The longer side = 11x = (11 × 4√3) = 44√3 m

**∴ The required longer side is 44√3 m**

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 15 hours and 12 hours, respectively. Pipe C alone can empty the full tank in 10 hours. If all the three pipes are opened together for 2 hours 40 minutes, then what part of the tank will remain unfilled?

Pipe A can fill a tank = 15 hours

Pipe B can fill a tank = 12 hours

Pipe C alone can empty the full tank = 10 hours

Work = Efficiency × Time

LCM of 15, 12 and 10 is 60

Efficiency of Pipe A = (60/15) = 4

Efficiency of Pipe B = (60/12) = 5

Efficiency of Pipe C = (60/10) = 6

Now,

All the three pipes are opened together = [(4 + 5) – 6]

⇒ (9 – 6) = 3

All the three pipes are opened together for 2 hour 40 min = [(120 + 40)/60 × 3] = (160/60 × 3)

⇒ 8 hours

The remaining part of the tank unfilled = (60 – 8)/60

⇒ (52/60)

⇒ 13/15

**∴ The required** **value is 13over15**

questions.question: The ratio of the volume of a cone and a cylinder is 8 ∶ 9 and their heights are in the ratio of 2 ∶ 3. What is the ratio of the radii of their bases?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the volume of a cone and a cylinder = 8 : 9

The ratio of their heights = 2 : 3

**Formula used:**

Volume of the cone = 1/3πr²h

Volume of the cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation:**

Let radius of Cone and Cylinder be R and r respectively

⇒ (1/3 × π × R² × 2)/(π × r² × 3) = 8/9

⇒ (2R²/3) × 9 = 3r² × 8

⇒ 6R² = 24r²

⇒ R² = 4r²

⇒ R²/r² = 4/1

⇒ R/r = 2/1

**∴ The ratio of the radii of their bases is 2 : 1**
